description: Awesome Grid Model Data (open electricity grid model datasets) is a curated catalogue listed in Awesome Grid Model Data, a curated list of electricity grid model datasets, published or maintained by Open Energy Transition. It lists publicly available electricity grid model datasets for production-cost, power-flow and dynamic studies, grouped by modelling tool (PLEXOS, PowerWorld, PSSE, PSLF, PowerFactory, PyPSA, MATPOWER) and by provider, including system-operator planning models and academic and synthetic test systems. Coverage: worldwide, with models for Australia, the United States, Ireland, Chile, Peru, New Zealand and Europe. The list carries a disclaimer that it does not host the datasets and that some need commercial software. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC0-1.0 for the list itself; the linked datasets carry their own terms. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support sourcing grid models for power-system studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-awesome-grid-model-data.
